description: The bar chart compares the performance of two sampling strategies—Fine-to-Coarse Sampling Strategy (purple bars) and Uniform Sampling Strategy (yellow bars)—across different values of the parameter $ m $, which ranges from 6 to 10 on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis represents the MAP@10 metric, with values ranging from 23.0 to 27.0. For each value of $ m $, two bars are displayed: the purple bar for the Fine-to-Coarse strategy and the yellow bar for the Uniform strategy. The Fine-to-Coarse strategy consistently achieves higher MAP@10 scores than the Uniform strategy across all $ m $ values. Specifically, the MAP@10 values for the Fine-to-Coarse strategy range from approximately 25.9 to 26.8, while the Uniform strategy's values range from about 24.4 to 25.6. The chart includes a legend in the upper right corner that identifies the color coding for each sampling strategy.
